tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Discover indexed arXiv papers using titles, authors and abstracts to assess relevance.
Prefer an English research topic or question, preserving important entities and phrases.
For broad questions, consider distinct research dimensions and query each as useful.
Independent queries can run concurrentl

tools.name: get_scout
tools.description:
Read a structured paper-based analysis of key signals, methodology, evidence,
experimental conditions and verification points, with author-stated limitations
where available. Use it when these details help assess a candidate, compare findings,
or understand the context of a claim beyond the abstract

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description:
Check Scout quota, usage, remaining allowance and reset time, along with plan and
entitlement details. Entitlement expiry and quota reset time describe different events.
